mechanism: Bumetanide-induced electrolyte depletion (hypokalemia, hyponatremia) and dehydration may potentiate CNS depression and increase alprazolam sensitivity, while loop diuretics can increase benzodiazepine levels through volume depletion and altered renal clearance.
action: Monitor electrolytes and renal function regularly; assess for excessive CNS depression; consider alternative diuretic if possible or use lowest effective alprazolam dose with close clinical monitoring.
